description: Primary ball selection chose track 286: slow upward drift at (0.85-0.91, 0.34-0.45), 2040-2560ms — background/far-court motion, not the ball. regressionExpectation: After the fix this clip must yield ball UNTRACKED (or a genuine ball track), never this drift track.
